meta.title: PI7 IDoc listener hangs while its JVM stays up
meta.faultOneLine: AN_COMMON_PI7IDOCListner stops consuming IDocs from SAP PI7 hub CE; nothing enters the platform

diagnosis.incident_summary: Deliveries from SAP PI7 hub CE have not entered HIP since 13:30 UTC (no new exchanges, no lag, no failed or stuck exchanges) while the IDoc listener AN_COMMON_PI7IDOCListner shows healthy JVM metrics but has stopped its heartbeat; CZ01 and a second warehouse are blocked (INC10790202).

hypotheses.cause: The IDoc listener node AN_COMMON_PI7IDOCListner has stopped consuming from hub CE (hung) while its JVM stays up, so nothing enters HIP.

supports.why: The listener's own heartbeat, emitted every 60 s regardless of traffic, stops after 13:30:12.
Heartbeat is absent for 5 minutes, then 30 (e-0092) and 120 (e-0191); it never resumes.
Inbound exchanges from hub CE fall from ~180 per 5 minutes to 0 at the same time.
The UK hub keeps flowing (115 vs 120 baseline), so the platform is not down; the fault is specific to the CE listener.

contradicts.why: The listener's health endpoint returns 200 UP after the hang, and continues to (e-0192); a hung consumer that still reports healthy is unusual.
Heap (40%), CPU (~11%) and thread count on the listener pods are indistinguishable from baseline, so there is no resource signature of a hang.

hypotheses.what_would_change_this: A listener thread dump showing consumer threads blocked, or SAP reporting IDocs queued for delivery, would raise it to High; an empty SAP outbound queue would move weight to hypothesis 2.

hypotheses.cause: SAP PI7 hub CE stopped sending IDocs (source-side outage or network path), so the listener is idle rather than hung.

supports.why: The HIPMON NO DATA rule reports nothing received from SAPCE/PI7 for 60 minutes, consistent with a silent source.
The Manhattan receipt monitor reports no delivery IDoc from hub CE within its 45-minute SLA.

contradicts.why: An idle-but-healthy listener would still heartbeat every 60 s; the heartbeat stopped 24 seconds after the last exchange, which points at the listener, not the source.
Hub UK continues to deliver normally, so a general SAP or network outage is not in evidence; only hub CE is silent.

hypotheses.what_would_change_this: An empty SAP outbound queue for hub CE with no IDocs generated since 13:30 would make this the leading cause; IDocs waiting in the queue would close it.

hypotheses.cause: Manhattan-side receipt problem (the warehouse system is failing to accept or register deliveries).

supports.why: The SLA alert originates from the Manhattan delivery-receipt monitor.

contradicts.why: Zero exchanges are being created inside HIP before the Manhattan hop, so deliveries never reach Manhattan to be accepted or rejected.
A replay query for FAILED or INPROGRESS DELVRY07 exchanges since 13:30 matches nothing: there is no failed hop to point at.

hypotheses.what_would_change_this: FAILED exchanges on the Manhattan-facing half-flow, or Manhattan errors in the same window, would raise it.

ruled_out.candidate: Processing-group saturation or a consumer pile-up (the pattern in large-mapping incidents)
ruled_out.reason: Consumer lag is 0 on all seven groups (e-0070), heap is flat (e-0066, e-0067), and a query for FAILED or INPROGRESS exchanges since 13:30 returns nothing (e-0128). A pile-up would show growth in all three; nothing is entering to pile up.

ruled_out.candidate: HIP replay / reprocess as a fix
ruled_out.reason: L1's YODI reprocess matched 0 exchanges (e-0126, e-0128): there is nothing failed inside HIP to replay; the deliveries never arrived.

ruled_out.candidate: Standing host alerts: SGLORHIPQETLPC1 swap 90% and FRHIPGQAMFTSI01 CPU 98%
ruled_out.reason: Recurring non-production host alerts (e-0007, e-0021), present before 13:30 and unrelated to the listener pods.

ruled_out.candidate: Background HIPMON alerts on SAPTR_FOM flows
ruled_out.reason: Different project and error strings (e-0022, e-0034: HTTP 503, missing field), present at baseline, none on the PI7 inbound flow.

ruled_out.candidate: A recent change to the listener or platform
ruled_out.reason: The change records in the window (e.g. e-0023 QA host patch, e-0093 Schema Registry key rotation) concern other components; none touches AN_COMMON_PI7IDOCListner or hub CE. The absence of a relevant change is itself noted.

checks.action: Count exchanges created from each PI7 hub in the last 15 minutes and check for INPROGRESS growth
checks.command: Sonar: filter exchange:EMEA_SAPCE_PI7_IDOC_DELVRY07_TO_MANH, last 15 minutes, count by exchange.status; compare with hub UK
checks.if_result_a: 0 new exchanges and no INPROGRESS growth while other hubs flow: a no-inflow incident, not a pile-up (hypotheses 1/2)
checks.if_result_b: New exchanges with growing INPROGRESS and lag: a pile-up; use the processing-group playbook instead

checks.action: Ask SAP Basis for the outbound queue state for hub CE's destination to HIP
checks.command: SAP: SMQ1 / SM58 - queue and tRFC status for the RFC destination to the HIP listener, entries since 13:30 UTC
checks.if_result_a: IDocs queued with delivery attempts timing out: the listener is not accepting (hypothesis 1)
checks.if_result_b: Queue empty and no IDocs generated since 13:30: source-side (hypothesis 2)

checks.action: Take a thread dump of the listener pods
checks.command: kubectl exec -n hip-cloud-esb hip-pi7-idoc-listener-1cfe69370-vjvwp -- jcmd 1 Thread.print | grep -c BLOCKED
checks.if_result_a: Consumer threads BLOCKED on socket read: confirms a hung listener (hypothesis 1)
checks.if_result_b: Threads idle/waiting on an empty queue: points at no data arriving (hypothesis 2)

downstream_degraded: Manhattan WMS delivery receipt (CZ01 and a second warehouse)
Warehouse picking and dispatch (INC10790202, Major incident declared 17:17)
blast_radius.business_objects_at_risk: Deliveries from SAP hub CE not received since 13:30. Nothing is stuck inside HIP (0 exchanges); the IDocs are waiting outside it.

recovery.proposal: Restart the AN_COMMON_PI7IDOCListner deployment one pod at a time, confirm the heartbeat resumes and inbound exchanges return, then ask SAP Basis to resend the hub CE IDocs queued since 13:30. Do not use HIP replay: there is nothing failed inside HIP (e-0128).
recovery.risk: IDocs in flight at the moment of restart may be lost or duplicated; the SAP resend can duplicate deliveries already processed around 13:29:48, so de-duplicate on IDoc number; the deployment may also serve other hubs, so watch hub UK during the restart.
recovery.rollback: If the heartbeat does not resume within 2 minutes, roll back to the previous ReplicaSet and escalate to Azure/Platform; SAP can keep IDocs queued, so no data is lost while the listener is down.

diagnosis.post_incident_note: #01 -Analysis/Root cause: [Hypothesis, pending thread dump / SAP queue check] AN_COMMON_PI7IDOCListner stopped consuming from hub CE at 13:30:12 UTC (heartbeat absent since, JVM health UP, heap/CPU flat); zero inbound exchanges from hub CE since 13:29:48; consumer lag 0 on all groups; HIP replay matched 0 exchanges. #02-Resolution/Flow state: [Proposed, awaiting approval] rolling restart of the listener, then SAP resend of queued hub CE IDocs from 13:30. #03-Doc used: NA #04- Related records (PRB, Change, Incident, RITM...): INC10790202 with INC10790321, INC10790322; no related change record found.

diff.changed_summary: SAP reports 214 IDocs queued for hub CE with delivery attempts timing out, and a listener thread dump shows every consumer thread blocked on socket read: the source is not silent, the listener is hung. Hypothesis 1 moves from Moderate to High and the source-side outage is closed out.
what_changed: e-late-0001 answers the discriminating check: SAP holds 214 IDocs for hub CE and its delivery attempts time out with no ACK. The source is generating and trying to send, which directly contradicts hypothesis 2.

The thread dump (all consumer threads BLOCKED on socket read) explains the puzzle in hypothesis 1's contradicts column: a listener can report health UP and normal heap/CPU while its consumer threads are stuck.
Recovery gains a safe follow-up: the 214 IDocs are preserved on the SAP side, so a listener restart followed by an SAP resend should lose no deliveries.
Hypothesis 3 is unchanged: still no failed exchange on the Manhattan hop.

diagnosisAfterOverrides.incident_summary: Deliveries from SAP PI7 hub CE have not entered HIP since 13:30 UTC because the IDoc listener AN_COMMON_PI7IDOCListner is hung (its consumer threads are blocked and SAP holds 214 undelivered IDocs) while JVM health still reports UP; CZ01 and a second warehouse are blocked (INC10790202).

1.what_would_change_this: Only resumed heartbeats without any intervention, or a thread dump showing idle consumer threads, would lower it now.

2.what_would_change_this: Effectively closed: SAP is generating IDocs and attempting delivery (214 queued); would reopen only if SAP reports the queue was created by a retry of stale messages.
